text:
sam: FYI — multiple customers opened tickets with 401s after last night's secret-sweeper job. SSO proxy returning `invalid_api_key` for keys that were 'blacklisted'. Can we triage? :eyes:

sam: repro curl from a customer:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_oldkey123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key revoked"}
```

maggie: I'm on it. Which tenants and how many? Are these keys stored in Vault KV v2 or in our key DB? Any correlating deploys?

sam: initial set: tenant-acme, tenant-pico, tenant-sprout — ~9 distinct keys across eu-west. Vault KV v2 for most; a few were legacy entries in key-db. No deploys around midnight except the sweeper cron (00:05 UTC). vault-bot posted: "secret-sweeper completed 00:07 UTC — flagged 42 orphaned keys as revoked"

vault-bot: secret-sweeper run summary: flagged 42 secrets (kv-v2) with metadata.revoked=true; no version writes performed for flagged keys; archived audit events to /audit/secrets/sweeper/468001

diego: I can reproduce locally. The sweeper PR (##332) changed behaviour to set metadata.revoked=true instead of creating a new version with a tombstone. Our sidecar secret agent only watches `data.version` changes to trigger hot-reload — it ignores metadata changes. Net effect: vault shows revoked=true but pod env still has old key. Meanwhile auth pipeline reads metadata to populate the blacklist store, so the key is rejected and inbound requests = 401.

carol: Confirmed on infra side — SSO proxy periodically pulls blacklist from auth-store. We updated the blacklist on sweeper write, so proxy sees the key as revoked immediately. Sidecars + some lambda envs didn't pick up metadata-only revokes. That mismatch is the root cause.

maggie: Good find. Can we get repro steps for support so we can tell customers?

diego: Steps to reproduce locally:
1) Create kv-v2 secret `secret/apps/tenant-x/api-key` version 3 with value `sk_test_old`
2) Have sidecar agent read version 3 into env
3) Run sweeper that sets `metadata.revoked=true` on the secret (no version write)
4) Verify vault metadata shows revoked:true but `data.version` still 3
5) Call API with `sk_test_old` -> 401 from SSO proxy while pod still using same key

carol: Short-term mitigation: rolled back last sweeper run (disabled cron) and pushed a quick auth-store purge to remove newly added blacklist entries created by that sweep. That restores access for tenants where sidecars still had the old key.

maggie: Which tenants got rollback? Any customer comms drafted? Support will need a templated explanation and ETA.

sam: Rolled back sweep for production namespace at 01:12 UTC. Affected tenants: tenant-acme, tenant-pico, tenant-sprout and 6 others (we have list in the sweeper audit). Support draft: short apology + "we disabled a maintenance job that incorrectly flagged certain keys as revoked; we are rolling a fix and will follow up within 2 hours".

diego: Longer-term fixes proposed:
- Update sweeper to perform a versioned tombstone write (increment kv-v2 version) instead of metadata-only flag so sidecar agents detect changes
- Update sidecar agent to watch `metadata` keys (revoked) in addition to version number
- Add unit/integration test that simulates metadata-only revokes and ensures envs update
- Add a safelist window in auth-store: do not enforce blacklist for 1 minute after a metadata write unless version incremented (to avoid transient mismatch)

carol: Ops tasks: schedule a canary rollout of sidecar agent change to dev clusters tomorrow morning, and deploy sweeper fix after sidecar rollout. Also add a metric/alert: `sweeper.revokes_without_version` > 0.

maggie: Support action items: send initial comms now, follow-up after we have a patch ETA, escalate any enterprise customers to account execs. I'll start the template and tag @accounts for enterprise outreach.

sam: Status update 00:45 UTC: rollback + auth-store purge restored access for ~80% impacted callers. We're tracking remaining ~20% (mostly Lambdas and legacy workers that cache secrets differently).

diego: I'll prep the PR to have sweeper write a tombstone version and add a migration script to bump keys that are currently metadata-only revoked. Targeting hotfix PR in 2 hours.

carol: Created alert and recorded runbook steps in #incidents. After fix we should run a coordinated sweep with sidecar rollout to avoid repeat.

maggie: Thanks team — I'll update customer tickets with interim message and mark P1 until patch is live.

sam: marking thread resolved once hotfix deploy + verification complete. :white_check_mark:
